name: Battle 5 — The Weirgate
briefing: The raid was the tide feeling ahead of itself. Now the main host comes on — heavy, slow, and led by Bulwark, who watched Ashmere break and has carried the tide's word ever since.
The Weirgate carries the south road over the millwater on a narrow causeway. Water guards both flanks; the road is the only way across, three spans wide.
Hold the near end and the host is stalled at the water. Let enough of them across into your rear and the road to the city is open.
You sent the Gate Guard — two Heavies, a wall of foot, and three bows on the parapet. This is the fight it was built for: stand still and let them break on you.
